title: Oath and Hollow
author: Lior Okafor
blurb: Mirabel Kavanagh, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
